title: « You have to suffer » : A conversation with Girl in Red and Anders Danielson Lie
summary: "You have to suffer to create something of a value". 🎬 Premiering in the Quinzaine des Cinéastes section, the film’s protagonists, Girl in Red and Anders Danielsen Lie, spoke with France 24’s Stella Elgersma about navigating high and low expectations, both in life and in the creative process. #CannesFilmFestival #lowexpectations #Cannes2026
